title: The Narrowing Profit Boom
text:
The Narrowing Profit Boom

Thomas Gatley

Gavekal Dragonomics | 4 Sep 2026

China’s corporate profits are surging after years of little growth, and producer prices are rising again following roughly three years of deflation. But beneath the headline figures, the picture is considerably less rosy. The majority of industries are still posting losses and mired in deflation. And while every earnings cycle is uneven, the current upswing rests on an unusually narrow set of industries: coal, non-ferrous metals and chips account for nearly all the top-line gains. Unless those winners substantially expand their production capacity in the coming months—which seems unlikely—the profit boom will probably remain concentrated in just a few pockets of the industrial sector.
